Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark spots and yellowing on older leaves.
Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Remove infected leaves and improve air circulation.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Avoid overhead watering and maintain proper plant spacing.

Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Remove infected plant material and use appropriate fungicide.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Avoid excessive moisture and maintain good airflow.

Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Olive-green or brown spots on leaves and fruit.
Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Remove infected leaves and use appropriate fungicide.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Keep the area clean and remove fallen infected leaves.
